title: Structura Reditus Publishing Protocol: Canon-facing publication, source, version, and repair discipline

tier_0: Publication-protocol rules for manuscript construction and publication conformance: every work declares mandate, non-goal, and reader result; claim burden bounded before drafting; source, evidence, code, version, and publication boundaries explicit; canon and entry audits separate; author-independence as durability test.

source_role: Publishing guidance per the handoff manifest; self-declared as the final Tier-0 publishing protocol and adopted working standard.
scope: Govern how local works enter, remain legible within, and are repaired inside the completed Structura Reditus corpus.
non_goal: Does not create Tier-1 proof, canon admission, DOI status, or public-release status by declaration alone; finalization does not publish any manuscript.

missingness.notes: The document self-declares as adopted working standard v1.0 (2026-08-28); the handoff manifest lists it as guidance; SR-GOV-000015 (rc1, 2026-08-29) names a 2026-08-28 working draft as its predecessor. Which document is the active publication protocol is not established by the sources and is not reconciled here.
Source object GCD / UMCP Publishing Protocol is not supplied or registered.

notes: Status unresolved rather than active or superseded: the sources disagree on adoption status and version order.
